latest.title: What is an Agent Harness? A Hands-On Guide With AgentCore harness
latest.description: An agent harness is the runtime that turns a model into an autonomous agent. I built one with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Harness using only configuration. Here's what a harness is, how AgentCore harness works, and code you can run today.

latest.title: Amazon Connect: Using Data Tables
latest.description: This guide walks you through creating a Data Table in Amazon Connect to store a list of phone numbers, and then configuring a contact flow to check whether an incoming caller's phone number exists in that table.

latest.title: AWS Builder Center: Como o Ecossistema Está Redefinindo o Aprendizado em Cloud Computing
latest.description: Começar na área de tecnologia pode parecer desafiador, especialmente quando o assunto é computação em nuvem. Com tantos serviços, conceitos e possibilidades, é comum não saber por onde iniciar. É exatamente nesse cenário que surge o AWS Builder Center, uma plataforma pensada para guiar desenvolvedores, estudantes e entusiastas desde os primeiros passos até níveis mais avançados de construção na nuvem.

latest.title: Reference Architecture: Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock
latest.description: Reference architecture for deploying Claude Code with Amazon Bedrock in enterprise environments. Covers identity federation (Okta/Entra ID), MDM-enforced settings, per-user cost attribution via CUR 2.0, prompt caching, compliance logging, and developer productivity metrics via OpenTelemetry. Built on the open-source guidance-for-claude-code-with-amazon-bedrock solution.

latest.title: How Millions Watch IPL Without Crashing Apps, And How You Can Learn the Same Tech
latest.description:
The AWS Builder Center lets students explore real cloud technology hands-on with free, risk-free environments and guided workshops.
It’s a simple way to understand how platforms like Amazon Web Services power massive real-time experiences like IPL streaming.

latest.description: This post explores how the Amazon Web Services Free Tier empowers beginners to learn cloud by doing, not just watching. It focuses on building real projects, understanding common challenges, and following a practical path to develop real-world cloud skills.

trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
